content.text:
Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: High-risk single-target review detected (high-risk single target, review/audit, tests/verification).

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: review the payment webhook handler for security regressions with concrete findings
- independent track 2: identify missing tests and verification gaps for the payment webhook handler
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_reviewer
  mode: read-only
  scope: payment webhook handler security review
  expected output: real findings, evidence, confidence
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: payment webhook handler missing tests
  expected output: targeted tests and commands
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
